'''The Hoary Piffer''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Lone Wolf" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> it was patronized by [[Catuman]] warriors and [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Gender/Legends|Wolfwomen]], while its entrance was the site of an encounter between fugitive [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Vima-Da-Boda]].<ref name="Lone Wolf" />
